_meta.name: Kamilight — Phase 3: Automated Follow-Up Engine
_meta.description: Hourly check → finds contacts whose follow-up is due → sends WhatsApp → updates Sheet → notifies admin of replies

follow_up_intervals.notes: Days since Last Contacted before follow-up triggers. Adjust in Config tab.

follow_up_messages.cold: Hello {name}, just checking in from Kamilight Global Logistics. We help businesses move cargo efficiently across Africa. Would you be open to a quick conversation about your freight needs?
follow_up_messages.warm: Hi {name}, following up from Kamilight. We'd love to help with your logistics. Do you have 10 minutes to connect this week?
follow_up_messages.potential client: Hello {name}, this is Kamilight Global Logistics. We reached out earlier about freight solutions. Are you still exploring options? We have competitive rates available.
follow_up_messages.high potential: Hi {name}, our team has been working on a proposal tailored to your business. Can we share it with you this week?

incoming_reply_handler.description: Separate webhook workflow to handle WhatsApp replies
incoming_reply_handler.trigger: WhatsApp sends POST to your webhook URL when contact replies
actions: Find contact in Google Sheets by phone
Send Telegram notification to admin with contact name + their reply
incoming_reply_handler.admin_notification_format:
📩 Reply from {name} ({phone}):

"{their_message}"

Tag: {tag}
Action: Reply via WhatsApp or update their stage in the sheet.
